limitations: Eight-assessment historical slice, with recovered stable provenance only. All eight assessments await substantive review; the other 45 provisional coverage rows, profile comparison and integrated P15 acceptance remain unfinished. No architecture selected.

requirements.assessment: The repaired manuscript defines frozen packages, page/section reconciliation, dispositions and bounded reference traversal. The older Apple manifest says the proxy is not acquired; P02 subsequently acquired selected proxy passages for Part III items 10–14. Remaining indentures, series instruments, omitted instruments and full incorporated-item meaning are unresolved. P01 inventories 192 reports; P02 retains unresolved meaning in all 23 notes. Neither establishes package semantic closure.
requirements.remaining_work: Specify an acceptance package covering annual, quarterly and semi-annual inventory rules, missing headings/continuations, duplicate/cyclic, unavailable and ambiguous references and resource-limit exit. Link outstanding references to affected queries; reconcile the older manifest with later acquisition evidence without rewriting either.
requirements.design_consequence: Expose acquired-unit, reviewed-assertion and query-specific simulation populations separately. An incomplete assertion inventory cannot support a percentage of all financial meaning. Later incorporated information cannot be backdated.

requirements.assessment: The manuscript and core contract specify entity/perimeter, measurement/basis, currency/unit, calendar and dimensions, exact rational values, display text and sign, and explicit conversions. P02 preserves literal 364,980, scale 6 and USD 364980000000 for Apple assets; source readings bind the cell to its row, date and in-millions header. However P02 applies closed half-unit nearest-rounding intervals while recording the issuer tie rule as unknown. The core contract says unknown rounding convention is unresolved, not an assumed half-unit interval. This is an unresolved policy reconciliation, not checked general conformance. P03 checks a bounded USD debt profile and expressly excludes wider currencies/calendars/entities.
requirements.remaining_work: Specify a uniform distinction between reported precision, known nearest rounding with unknown tie treatment, and an assumed rounding model. Label P02 half-unit bounds as a conditional compatibility model unless source evidence supports the rounding convention. Define accepted/rejected context operations, faithful rendering, missingness/sign rules and explicit measurement/FX/partition transformations for the broader product.
requirements.design_consequence: Preserve both source display and exact interpreted quantity; a numeric value alone cannot carry meaning. Same-currency addition still needs compatible contexts. Nearest-rounding envelopes are conditional assumptions unless justified; compatibility is not identification of the underlying amount.

requirements.assessment: Narrative records now include modality, quantifier, qualification, affected observations, translation and review. The text distinguishes permission from obligation, conditional guarantees from recognised liabilities and qualitative language from assumed thresholds. Apple explicitly describes swaps converting some fixed coupons to floating exposure; P02 retains unidentified debt/hedge allocation. This is selected interpretation, not complete narrative translation.
requirements.remaining_work: Define explicit scope/date/exception/context binding and separate translation acceptance from extraction acceptance. Provide literal-to-constraint or unresolved cases for policies, permissions, conditional commitments, qualifications and cross-references, including rejection of invented thresholds and of coupon-type constraints applied to combined note-plus-swap exposure.
requirements.design_consequence: Unsupported narratives remain query-visible even without a current statement amount. Added numeric restrictions require assumption lineage; accepted extraction alone cannot authorise a constraint.

requirements.assessment: The manuscript distinguishes immutable reported assertions, readings, derivations, assumptions and conflict sets. It explicitly separates OCR 720→120 from the issuer correction 120→110. P07 has actual transition/invalidation tests: reject the erroneous reading, preserve a faithful original, supersede it with a later reported correction, retain the old report and reject stale current or late-created descendants. Accepted extraction does not validate accounting. The general source/derived/assumed propagation remains broader than this synthetic workflow.
requirements.remaining_work: Specify layer-specific admission and status propagation through each transformation, including a real conflicting-disclosure example with exact source spans and explicit alternatives. Generalise the bounded dependency/invalidation examples without inferring credibility probabilities from review status.
requirements.design_consequence: Sources remain immutable and alternative readings survive. New views may invalidate dependencies while old frozen results remain reproducible under their original evidence. A reported revision must not be described as an extraction correction.

requirements.assessment: The repaired design specifies distinct economic/reporting, availability and database clocks, named original/latest/harmonised views, eligible selective supersession, conflicts, half-open intervals and compatible cumulative subtraction. Northstar supplies exact query results and valid 260−110=150 versus rejected mixed-vintage 260−120=140. P06 implements a bounded version, but select_evidence substitutes availability when ingested is absent and defaults require_known_bytes to false. It retains unknown availability as unresolved; selected assertions may still lack established historical byte vintage. These defaults cannot be silently adopted as investor-information or database-history guarantees.
requirements.remaining_work: Specify separate eligibility for archival exploration, investor-information and system-as-of queries. Missing ingestion must not be silently replaced by publication for system-history claims. Require or explicitly qualify historical-byte evidence for as-of evaluation. Expand dated fixtures for missing timestamps, timezones, incompatible calendars/perimeters, selective conflicts and prospective versus retrospective changes.
requirements.design_consequence: An archive retrieved today can reconstruct an earlier investor view only with justified availability and version evidence. System visibility needs ingestion evidence. Latest stored data and declared filing dates alone cannot establish what was knowable.

gaps.assessment: The old claim that no coverage/translation procedure exists is stale. The repaired chapter defines separate denominators, traversal and stop conditions, while Narrative and CoverageUnit give record shapes. The gap persists in demonstrated whole-package inventory and reviewed meaning: P02 reports zero fully formalised notes and 23 notes with unresolved meaning.
gaps.remaining_work: Retain full MC01/MC03 scope: reconciled package, typed narrative examples, cross-reference closure or precise outstanding obligations, and disclosure-to-constraint links carrying qualifications. Specify review of headings and table continuations before asserting a complete semantic denominator.
gaps.design_consequence: Credit the procedure repair without closing whole-report coverage. Files, pages, notes and checked bridges measure different populations and cannot certify complete financial meaning.

gaps.assessment: The older blanket absence of historical query rules has been repaired: the manuscript now provides eligibility filtering, selective acyclic supersession, maximal conflicts and named views, with exact publication/ingestion fixtures. The bounded P06 implementation is useful exploratory evidence. Wider MC19 dated accounting-treatment transitions and MC25 complete version/API semantics are not closed by temporal arithmetic or the small fixture.
gaps.remaining_work: Resolve missing-ingestion/byte-vintage policy and provide fixtures for eligible conflicting corrections, unrelated unchanged notes, unknown publication times and invalid cross-calendar/basis/perimeter subtraction. Specify prospective estimate and retrospective error/policy transitions with applicable authority, explicit effective dates and opening bridges; those authority decisions remain for MC19/P17.
gaps.design_consequence: Preserve clocks and treatment-version selection as separate contracts. The same economic date can support different legitimate views, but a harmonised transformation never overwrites its source. No general standards-transition validity follows from the Northstar arithmetic.

gaps.assessment: The manuscript and P07 now specify Proposed, Accepted, AcceptedAlternative, Rejected and Superseded transitions, required rationale/context/reconciliation, append-only decisions, conflicts, old-view preservation and transitive invalidation. Historical P07 evidence includes late-descendant and unrelated-source cases. The old omission finding is therefore substantially repaired. Complete MC27 analyst workflow, real conflict adjudication and layer-aware general dependency semantics remain open.
gaps.remaining_work: Integrate the local transition table and explicit accepted-layer contract into the whole-product proposal. Supply a source-backed conflict/alternative walkthrough from raw reading to changed conclusions, including invalid transitions, descendants and unaffected results. Preserve MC27 human workflow and acceptance separately; no multi-user hierarchy is required.
gaps.design_consequence: Review approval, extraction confidence, accounting validity and history probabilities remain different quantities. A new view must not reuse a stale result or silently attach old journals to new evidence; prior views remain reproducible.

open_decisions.question: When may a filing package be called complete?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Declare separate acquired-unit, reviewed-assertion and query-exposure populations and retain material unresolved incorporated targets.
open_decisions.alternative: A single completeness score or closure only over acquired files.
open_decisions.consequence: An aggregate score could conceal absent contracts and overstate downstream support.
open_decisions.next_step: Specify a reconciled annual/interim package with duplicate, unavailable, ambiguous and resource-limited references and query consequences.

open_decisions.question: How does a narrative reading become a constraint?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Bind scope, time, modality, exceptions and contexts explicitly; accept translation separately and label added thresholds as assumptions.
open_decisions.alternative: Free-text scope with generic acceptance and implementation-defined translation.
open_decisions.consequence: Implementations could turn permissions into payments or fixed coupons into fixed aggregate exposure.
open_decisions.next_step: Specify positive and rejected translations and unresolved-predicate effects in the evidence/language contracts.

open_decisions.question: May source preparation infer a half-unit interval from displayed precision when the rounding rule is unknown?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Separate display precision from the issuer rounding convention; retain unknowns and permit a named conditional nearest-rounding compatibility model with explicit assumption provenance.
open_decisions.alternative: Treat the displayed unit as sufficient evidence for a half-unit interval, or reject all conditional rounding analysis.
open_decisions.consequence: The first overstates source support; the second prevents useful conditional analysis. Existing P02 and the general contract are not yet aligned on this distinction.
open_decisions.next_step: Inspect the unit and rounding disclosures, distinguish unknown nearest convention from unknown tie rule, and specify assumption-labelled examples with missing and known rounding metadata.

open_decisions.question: Which missing time/version fields may a query tolerate?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Keep exploratory archival results explicitly qualified; reject or return unresolved for system-as-of claims without ingestion evidence and for investor-information evaluation without justified availability and byte vintage.
open_decisions.alternative: Carry P06 defaults forward: infer ingestion from availability and select unknown-vintage bytes by default.
open_decisions.consequence: The alternative can produce results labelled as historical knowledge that the retained evidence does not establish.
open_decisions.next_step: Specify distinct query admission modes and fixtures for absent versus explicit-null ingestion, unknown publication and unverified bytes, then reconcile P06 with the proposal.

open_decisions.question: What does review acceptance authorise across extraction and interpretation layers?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Name the accepted layer, preserve alternatives/conflicts, and propagate status and transitive invalidation through explicit dependencies.
open_decisions.alternative: One undifferentiated accepted status usable as an accounting constraint.
open_decisions.consequence: A faithful extraction of a disputed or incorrect assertion could otherwise become an endorsed treatment.
open_decisions.next_step: Specify a real source-backed conflict walkthrough and cross-layer transition/admission examples under MC04/MC27 before general workflow acceptance.
